description.fun: Torkoal digs up coal, packs it into its shell and burns it for energy; if the fire inside goes out, it dies. You can tell a healthy one by how hard the smoke shoots out of its shell, and when it blows smoke it sounds like a locomotive's horn. Its name mixes tortoise and coal, and it also sounds like kotatsu, a Japanese heated table once warmed by coal.
description.guide: A Fire-type Pokémon based on a tortoise with a coal-burning shell, living in mountains and volcanic areas. When attacked, it blows black smoke from its nostrils and flees. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A coal-burning tortoise that toots like a steam train
